Academic Excellence

CBSE Curriculum

Our school follows the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) curriculum, providing a nationally recognized framework that emphasizes conceptual clarity, analytical thinking, and practical applications. Subjects range from the core sciences and mathematics to languages, social studies, and elective specializations.

Computer Science Program

The school's dedicated computer science program goes beyond textbook theory. Students learn Python, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and database fundamentals through hands-on projects. It was this program that planted the seeds for Class Of Learners � encouraging us to build real tools rather than just study about them.

Impact

Why This School Matters to CoL

Class Of Learners was born inside these walls. The school's emphasis on computer science and hands-on learning gave us the confidence to attempt building real-world applications. Our teachers, particularly our mentor Sanjana Kasbe, encouraged us to push beyond the syllabus — to write actual software, debug real problems, and collaborate like a professional development team.

Every project in the CoL portfolio — from the 64-bit Solar Engine to the Advanced Typing Instructor — traces its roots back to the curiosity and discipline we developed here. The school didn't just teach us subjects; it taught us how to learn, how to build, and how to ship.
